decisions.quote: Thus, although we failed to replicate the original finding by Parker et al. (1981) using conventional measures of memory performance (i.e., cued and free recall), we did find clear-cut evidence in favor of an underlying retrieval benefit (i.e., an effect on EMR parameter r f ).
decisions.reason: While the authors failed to replicate Parker et al. (1981) on manifest recall measures (Hypotheses 1 and 2) and latent maintenance (Hypothesis 4), they confirmed a robust latent retrieval benefit in their preregistered MPT model (Hypothesis 3) and explicitly frame their overall findings in the title and Discussion summary as mixed evidence that alcohol-induced retrograde facilitation exists via retrieval enhancement.
